items.title: Bitcoin’s biggest bet is now a drop below $60,000, not a rally above $100,000
items.teaser: The $60,000 put has replaced the $100,000 call as bitcoin’s biggest options bet on Deribit, with $900 million in open interest after the recent slide.

items.title: Luxor CEO warns of AI ‘dark forest’ after Bitcoin miner hijack
items.teaser: Attackers redirected customers’ Bitcoin mining power through Luxor’s Commander platform over the weekend, prompting its CEO to issue a warning to crypto businesses.

items.title: US sellers drive Bitcoin crash, Jensen plots Nvidia comeback: Hodler’s Digest
items.teaser: Anchorage Digital data suggests the Bitcoin selloff is being driven by US investors. A “war room” has been set up by supporters to reinstate Nvidia boss Jensen Huang.

items.title: CZ denies Binance sold crypto as Bitcoin bounces from four-month low near $62,000
items.teaser: The price moves across the market led to $2 billion in crypto liquidations in a single 24-hour period over the weekend.

items.title: XRP crashes to its lowest since November 2024 as money leaves crypto
items.teaser: XRP tanked to its lowest level since November 2024 as ETF outflows and shrinking stablecoin supply add to pressure on crypto markets.
